fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire operational yard is enclosed by a tall tan block wall (confirmed on the Sunset Rd, north, and east sides in Street View). The only truck access is the NE-corner curb cut off the east street into the perimeter drive - a walled single-throat yard implies a controlled gate, but the gate hardware itself was not resolvable in z20 overhead or reachable Street View; flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth observed at the NE throat or front; front visitor lot on Sunset Rd is open car parking with the Pepsi-globe lobby (blue canopy). remoteGs=true follows from gate-without-shack but inherits the gate uncertainty.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West-face dock row toward the fleet yard (~12-14 trailers backed), east-face row (~6-8), plus north DC-section positions; 387,400 sq ft bottling+distribution building (Packaging Gateway) supports a 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite faces: west row serves route/fleet loading, east row faces the inbound perimeter drive.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer rows in the walled north yard (~18) and middle yard (~10), plus pallet/shell stacks; route trucks throughout.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Semis were queued curbside on the west street in 2022 Street View, but that street fronts a separate (ex-Helix Electric) laydown parcel - not counted as Pepsi staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main plant plus a SW outbuilding inside one walled campus; the trailer strip west of the wall is a separate parcel and was excluded from the perimeter.
